description: Claude Code plugin shipping six Archon YAML workflows covering the full AI development lifecycle (explore → plan → build → qa → cleanup → triage) with human approval gates, an idempotent install hook, and four tested Node.js modules.

userStories.title: Plugin scaffold
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the plugin directory structure scaffolded with all required meta-files so that the plugin is recognised by Claude Code, passes CI, and is ready for development.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.claude-plugin/plugin.json exists with name 'unic-archon-dlc', version '0.1.0', author Unic AG, license LGPL-3.0-or-later
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json exists with matching version and all required marketplace fields (displayName, category, tags, source)
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/package.json exists with type 'module', private true, and scripts: test, typecheck, bump, sync-version, tag, verify:changelog, ralph
package.json devDependencies use catalog: pinning for @ralph-orchestrator/ralph-cli, @types/node, typescript and workspace:* for @unic/release-tools, @unic/tsconfig
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/CHANGELOG.md exists with an initial [0.1.0] section placeholder
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/CLAUDE.md exists with project overview, commands reference, tech stack, code conventions, and scope guard
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/CONTEXT.md exists with domain vocabulary (DlcConfig, IssueTracker, BranchingStrategy, Workflow, WorkflowNode, Gate, Artifact, Slug)
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/PROMPT.md exists with Ralph orchestrator loop prompt referencing docs/plans/
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/ralph.yml exists with backend claude, prompt_file PROMPT.md, completion_promise LOOP_COMPLETE, max_iterations 100
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/tsconfig.json exists following the @unic/tsconfig base pattern with checkJs and noEmit
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/README.md exists as a skeleton (can be a placeholder with title only)
pnpm install succeeds from workspace root after adding the new package
userStories.technicalNotes: Mirror apps/claude-code/auto-format/ and apps/claude-code/pr-review/ exactly for directory layout. Copy package.json shape from apps/claude-code/auto-format/package.json — same scripts, same engine requirements (node >=22, pnpm >=10). Use catalog: pinning for devDeps (see pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog section). No src/ or dist/ — scripts/ and tests/ at plugin root. Do not create a LICENSE file — maintainer adds these manually.

userStories.title: Config loader/validator module
userStories.description: As a workflow node, I want a loadConfig(path) function that reads and validates .archon/unic-dlc.config.json so that all downstream code gets a typed, validated DlcConfig or a structured error list.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/scripts/lib/config.mjs exists and exports loadConfig(path: string): ConfigResult
loadConfig returns { ok: true, config } for a valid config JSON containing all mandatory fields
loadConfig returns { ok: false, errors: string[] } when issueTracker or branchingStrategy are missing
Unknown keys in the JSON are ignored without error

Valid config structure: issueTracker (github|ado|jira|local), branchingStrategy (gitflow|github-flow), tddMode (boolean), nyquistValidation (boolean), slopsquattingGate (boolean), modelProfile (balanced|fast|quality), e2eCommand (string|null), labels (object with state/type/priority maps)
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/tests/config.test.mjs exists using node:test and node:assert/strict
Tests cover: valid full config parses correctly, missing issueTracker returns error, missing branchingStrategy returns error, unknown keys ignored, missing file path returns error
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc typecheck passes with zero errors
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc test passes
userStories.technicalNotes: Use @ts-check + JSDoc throughout. Read file with node:fs/promises readFile. Return discriminated union { ok: true, config } | { ok: false, errors: string[] } — same pattern as packages/release-tools/scripts/lib/errors.mjs. Test pattern: node:test + node:assert/strict as in apps/claude-code/pr-review/tests/parse-signature.test.mjs. No external deps.

userStories.title: Project state explorer module
userStories.description: As the install hook, I want an exploreProject(projectRoot) function that reads existing project state before asking questions so that users are not prompted for things already configured.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/scripts/lib/explorer.mjs exists and exports exploreProject(projectRoot: string): Promise<ProjectSnapshot>

ProjectSnapshot has: gitRemote (string|null), hasClaudeMd (boolean), hasContextMd (boolean), hasContextMapMd (boolean), existingConfig (DlcConfig|null), archonInstalled (boolean), isMultiContext (boolean)
gitRemote is detected via spawnSync('git', ['remote', 'get-url', 'origin']); null if git command fails or no remote
archonInstalled is detected via spawnSync('archon', ['--version']); false if not on PATH
isMultiContext is true when CONTEXT-MAP.md exists in projectRoot
existingConfig is the parsed config from .archon/unic-dlc.config.json if it exists and is valid; null otherwise
Missing files are reported as absent (hasClaudeMd: false), not thrown as errors
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/tests/explorer.test.mjs exists with tests using node:os.tmpdir() temp directories
Tests cover: full project with all files returns correct snapshot; empty dir returns all absent/false; existing valid config is returned; missing config returns null
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc typecheck passes
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc test passes
userStories.technicalNotes: Use node:fs, node:path, node:os, node:child_process (spawnSync) only — no external deps. Import loadConfig from scripts/lib/config.mjs for existingConfig. Cross-platform: avoid shell=true in spawnSync. Test using real temp directories (mkdtempSync) rather than mocks.

userStories.title: Dependency tree builder
userStories.description: As the YAML generator, I want a buildDepTree(issues) function that converts issues.json into a topologically-sorted parallel group array so that the build workflow respects actual dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/scripts/lib/dep-tree.mjs exists and exports buildDepTree(issues: Issue[]): DepTreeResult
Issue input shape: { id: string, blocked_by: string[], testCommand: string }
DepTreeResult is { ok: true, groups: string[][] } | { ok: false, error: string, cycle: string[] }
Linear chain [A blocked_by none, B blocked_by [A], C blocked_by [B]] produces groups: [[A], [B], [C]]
Independent issues [A, B, C] all with empty blocked_by produce groups: [[A, B, C]]
Mixed: [A none, B none, C blocked_by [A]] produces groups: [[A, B], [C]]
Circular dependency [A blocked_by [B], B blocked_by [A]] returns ok: false with cycle array
Reference to non-existent issue ID returns ok: false with error string
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/tests/dep-tree.test.mjs covers all cases above
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc typecheck passes
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc test passes
userStories.technicalNotes: Implement Kahn's algorithm (BFS topological sort). Pure data transformation — no I/O, no side effects. Groups within a tier can be in any order. The cycle array should list the IDs forming the cycle for clear error messages. No external deps.

userStories.title: Issue tracker adapter
userStories.description: As a workflow bash node, I want a createTrackerAdapter(config) that generates correct CLI command strings for each supported tracker backend so that all workflows produce actionable, tracker-specific commands without branching on issueTracker at every call site.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/scripts/lib/tracker.mjs exists and exports createTrackerAdapter(config: DlcConfig): TrackerAdapter
TrackerAdapter has: createIssue(title, body, labels) => string, updateLabels(issueId, labels) => string, closeIssue(issueId) => string, mergePr(prId) => string
GitHub backend: createIssue returns 'gh issue create --title "<title>" --body "<body>" --label "<mapped-label>"'
ADO backend: createIssue returns 'az boards work-item create --title "<title>" --type Bug --field ...'
Jira backend: createIssue returns 'jira issue create --project ... --summary "<title>"'
Local markdown backend: createIssue returns a Node.js snippet comment string (not a shell command) describing the file to write
Canonical label names (needs-triage, ready-for-agent, resolved, closed, feature, bug, p0, p1, p2, p3) are translated to config.labels mapped strings
mergePr returns the correct CLI merge command per tracker (gh pr merge, az repos pr update, jira issue transition, null for local)
apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/tests/tracker.test.mjs covers all 4 backends for createIssue, updateLabels, closeIssue
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc typecheck passes
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc test passes
userStories.technicalNotes: Pure string generation — no I/O, no shell execution. Accepts DlcConfig (from config.mjs types). Canonical label map uses config.labels.state, config.labels.type, config.labels.priority. Test with a fixture config object per backend — no file I/O needed in tests.

userStories.title: Archon workflow YAML generator
userStories.description: As the plan workflow's yaml-gen bash node, I want a generateBuildYaml(slug, groups) function that converts a dep-tree groups array into a valid Archon build workflow YAML string so that each feature gets an execution graph matching its actual dependency tree.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/scripts/lib/yaml-gen.mjs exists and exports generateBuildYaml(slug: string, groups: string[][]): string
Output is a valid YAML string parseable without error
Single group [[A, B]] generates code-red-A and code-red-B as sibling nodes (no depends_on between them), followed by code-green-A and code-green-B as siblings
Two groups [[A], [B]] generates code-red-A → code-green-A → code-red-B → code-green-B as sequential nodes via depends_on
Output YAML has workflow name derived from slug ('build-<slug>')
Each issue gets a slopcheck node before its code-green node
Output has a global verification node depending on all code-green nodes
Output has a goals-check node depending on verification
Output has a report node depending on goals-check
Output has a human-review-gate (interactive: true) depending on report

apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/tests/yaml-gen.test.mjs covers single-group parallel and multi-group serial cases; validates output is syntactically valid YAML (at minimum: no tab indentation, colons present)
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc typecheck passes
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc test passes
userStories.technicalNotes: Use string template literals for YAML generation — no external yaml library. 2-space indentation for YAML output (Archon convention). Import buildDepTree from dep-tree.mjs in the yaml-gen bash node script (scripts/yaml-gen-cli.mjs) which is the actual executable called by the plan workflow; the lib function is the pure generator. YAML validation in tests: check no leading tabs, check key presence with regex.

userStories.title: Idempotent install hook
userStories.description: As a developer onboarding unic-archon-dlc, I want an install hook that explores the project, asks the minimum questions needed, and writes machine-readable config plus 5 human-readable docs/agents/ files so that setup is accumulative and every agent in the repo understands the workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/scripts/install.mjs exists with shebang #!/usr/bin/env node and is ESM
Hook calls exploreProject() before presenting any prompts; pre-existing values are shown as defaults and skippable with Enter
Hook verifies archon is on PATH first; exits with a clear error message if not found

Mandatory tier (always prompted on fresh install): issueTracker (auto-detected from git remote URL patterns: github.com → github, dev.azure.com → ado, atlassian.net → jira, else local), branchingStrategy (default: gitflow)
Skippable: e2eCommand (user can press Enter to leave null)
Auto-defaulted without prompting: tddMode true, nyquistValidation true, slopsquattingGate true, modelProfile balanced
Writes .archon/unic-dlc.config.json with all settings
Writes docs/agents/issue-tracker.md describing tracker backend and CLI commands
Writes docs/agents/labels.md with three-tier label taxonomy mapped to config.labels values
Writes docs/agents/branching.md with chosen strategy, branch naming, PR target conventions
Writes docs/agents/domain.md with single vs multi-context layout and CONTEXT.md/ADR paths
Writes docs/agents/workflow.md mapping each workflow phase to its artifact outputs
Appends '## Agent skills' block to CLAUDE.md listing the 5 docs/agents/ files; does not duplicate if block already present
Running hook a second time with existing config shows current values and skips re-writing unchanged files
Uses only node:fs, node:path, node:os, node:child_process, node:readline (no external deps)
userStories.technicalNotes: Use node:readline/promises for async prompts. Import exploreProject from scripts/lib/explorer.mjs and createTrackerAdapter from scripts/lib/tracker.mjs. The docs/agents/ file content is inline template strings in the hook — no separate template files. Idempotency: compare current file content before overwriting. Git remote auto-detection: spawnSync('git', ['remote', 'get-url', 'origin']), then URL pattern match.

userStories.title: Explore workflow YAML
userStories.description: As a developer starting on an unfamiliar integration, I want an explore.yaml Archon workflow with 4 parallel research agents, synthesize, prototype, code-preserve gate, and findings.md output so that technical feasibility is documented before planning begins.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.archon/workflows/explore.yaml exists
Has a parallel node grouping 4 sub-agents: research-stack, research-features, research-architecture, research-pitfalls
Has a synthesize node (type: prompt) that receives parallel research outputs and user's stated intent as context
Has a prototype node (type: prompt) that produces structured VALIDATED / INVALIDATED / PARTIAL verdicts per experiment
Has a code-preserve-gate node (interactive: true) asking if spike code is worth preserving on a branch
Has a save-findings bash node that writes $SLUG/findings.md to docs/workflow/<slug>/
Has a create-ticket bash node that runs the tracker adapter's createIssue command for a spike ticket
Workflow reads slug and intent from input parameters or env vars
File is valid YAML (no syntax errors)
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow Archon YAML conventions. Interactive nodes: interactive: true. Bash nodes: type: bash, command: node <script>. The parallel node groups sub-agents using Archon's parallel primitive. create-ticket bash node runs: node scripts/yaml-gen-cli.mjs or similar — check Archon docs for bash node invocation pattern.

userStories.title: Plan workflow YAML
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a plan.yaml Archon workflow with grill-with-docs interview, to-prd synthesis, two human PR gates, to-issues decomposition, Nyquist mapping, plan-checker loop with stall detection, and yaml-gen bash node so that a validated dependency-mapped plan is approved before any code is written.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.archon/workflows/plan.yaml exists
Has load-context bash node that reads CONTEXT.md, CONTEXT-MAP.md (if present), docs/adr/ and passes content as context
Has specs node (type: prompt, interactive: true) for adversarial grill-with-docs interview — one question at a time
Has write-adrs bash node that writes proposed ADR entries to docs/adr/<slug>-<n>.md
Has to-prd node (type: prompt) that synthesises the grilling session into a structured PRD
Has prd-gate (interactive: true) as the first human approval gate
Has to-issues node (type: prompt) that decomposes PRD into vertically-sliced issues with blocked_by arrays
Has nyquist-map node (type: prompt) that maps every issue to a testCommand
Has plan-checker loop node (type: loop, max_iterations: 3) validating consistency, completeness, decision coverage, Nyquist compliance
plan-checker stall detection: if issue count does not decrease between consecutive iterations, escalate to a stall-gate (interactive: true) instead of burning remaining retries
Has yaml-gen bash node that runs node scripts/yaml-gen-cli.mjs --slug $SLUG --issues docs/workflow/$SLUG/issues.json and writes .archon/workflows/build-$SLUG.yaml
Has plan-gate (interactive: true) as the second human approval gate
File is valid YAML
userStories.technicalNotes: Plan workflow depends on yaml-gen-cli.mjs (from US-006). Loop node uses Archon loop primitive. Stall detection can be implemented as a bash node that reads previous iteration's issue count from $ARTIFACTS_DIR and compares. The yaml-gen bash node must run: node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/yaml-gen-cli.mjs.

userStories.title: Build workflow template
userStories.description: As the yaml-gen function, I want a build-template.yaml that serves as the annotated structural reference for dynamically-generated build workflows so that the generator knows exactly which nodes to emit and in what shape.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.archon/workflows/build-template.yaml exists

Has annotated examples of: code-red node (type: prompt, per-issue), code-green node (type: prompt, per-issue), slopcheck bash node (runs slopcheck or marks [ASSUMED] if not on PATH), verification node (test suite + coverage + stub detection + wiring audit), goals-check node (PRD acceptance criteria coverage matrix), report bash node (writes docs/workflow/<slug>/report.md), human-review-gate (interactive: true)
Has a review command invocation node that calls .archon/commands/review.md
YAML comments (# notation) explain which nodes are per-issue vs. global and what the yaml-gen generator should replicate
Template is not executable as-is (can have placeholder values like ISSUE_ID_PLACEHOLDER)
File is valid YAML (placeholder values do not break YAML parsing)
userStories.technicalNotes: This is a reference template and documentation artifact, not an executed workflow. yaml-gen.mjs uses this structure as the pattern. Keep it self-documenting with comments. The per-issue nodes are the ones yaml-gen replicates N times; global nodes are emitted once.

userStories.title: QA workflow YAML
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a qa.yaml Archon workflow that enforces e2e pass → coverage gate → human UAT → merge so that human sign-off is always preceded by automated evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.archon/workflows/qa.yaml exists
Has run-e2e bash node that reads e2eCommand from config; if null, emits a warning and skips (does not fail)
Has coverage-gate bash node that parses coverage output (lcov/istanbul summary) and fails if line coverage < threshold (default 80%)
Has uat-gate node (interactive: true) that presents e2e results and UAT checklist from PRD to the human reviewer
Has merge-pr bash node that runs the tracker adapter's mergePr command using the configured tracker CLI
Node order enforced by depends_on: run-e2e → coverage-gate → uat-gate → merge-pr
File is valid YAML
userStories.technicalNotes: run-e2e bash node: node -e 'const cfg = require(".archon/unic-dlc.config.json"); if (!cfg.e2eCommand) { console.warn("e2eCommand not configured, skipping"); process.exit(0); } ...' (or equivalent). coverage-gate reads from coverage/lcov.info or coverage-summary.json. merge-pr node content varies per tracker — use the adapter's mergePr output.

userStories.title: Cleanup workflow YAML
userStories.description: As a developer, after a feature is merged, I want a cleanup.yaml Archon workflow with arch-review, per-ADR approval gates, and a triage node so that entropy is addressed and the project state is accurate after every ship.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.archon/workflows/cleanup.yaml exists
Has arch-review node (type: prompt) that reads docs/workflow/<slug>/PRD.md and docs/workflow/<slug>/report.md alongside codebase to identify shallow/tightly-coupled modules
Has adr-consolidation node (interactive: true) that presents each proposed ADR entry for per-ADR approval before writing
Has write-adrs bash node that writes approved ADRs to docs/adr/
Has triage node that either calls triage.yaml as a sub-workflow or inlines HANDOFF.md generation
Has update-roadmap bash node that writes docs/workflow/ROADMAP.md with current feature status
File is valid YAML
userStories.technicalNotes: arch-review prompt should explicitly reference PRD.md acceptance criteria vs. what was actually built (intent drift detection). adr-consolidation interactive node presents one ADR at a time for approval. update-roadmap bash node appends a dated status line to ROADMAP.md.

userStories.title: Triage workflow YAML
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a standalone triage.yaml Archon workflow that generates a HANDOFF.md snapshot so that AFK sessions can resume cleanly in a fresh context window.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.archon/workflows/triage.yaml exists
Has collect-state bash node that reads configured tracker for open issues and their current states (uses tracker adapter CLI commands)
Has generate-handoff node (type: prompt) that synthesises current phase, open issues, blockers, and recent decisions into HANDOFF.md content
Has write-handoff bash node that writes docs/workflow/HANDOFF.md
Has update-roadmap bash node that updates docs/workflow/ROADMAP.md
Workflow is self-contained — callable without any prior workflow having run
File is valid YAML
userStories.technicalNotes: This workflow doubles as both standalone on-demand status check and the final node of cleanup.yaml. Keep it independent — no $ARTIFACTS_DIR references from other workflows. collect-state can use 'gh issue list', 'az boards work-item list', 'jira issue list', or scan docs/issues/ depending on config.

userStories.title: Self-contained review Archon command
userStories.description: As a build workflow, I want a review.md Archon command that performs multi-aspect code review (code quality, test coverage, silent failures, type design) without requiring the pr-review-toolkit plugin so that the review step works in any project.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/.archon/commands/review.md exists
Has YAML frontmatter with allowed-tools, argument-hint (e.g. '<branch-name | pr-url>'), and description
Covers 4 review aspects as named sections: Code Quality, Test Coverage, Silent Failures, Type Design
Each section is a distinct agent prompt or instruction block with specific review criteria
Command accepts a target (branch name or PR URL) as $ARGUMENTS
Produces a structured review report with section headers per aspect and Pass / Needs Work / Fail verdicts
Has no runtime dependency on pr-review-toolkit — all review logic is self-contained in the markdown
File is valid markdown with valid YAML frontmatter
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow the command structure of apps/claude-code/pr-review/commands/review-pr.md. Inspired by pr-review-toolkit patterns (code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, pr-test-analyzer, type-design-analyzer) but self-contained. Allowed-tools should include Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Agent.

userStories.title: Plugin README with full documentation
userStories.description: As a developer reading the plugin README, I want a comprehensive README with Mermaid architecture diagram, node reference table, quick-start, configuration reference, and docs/workflow/ layout so that I can understand and adopt the plugin without reading YAML files.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/claude-code/unic-archon-dlc/README.md has a Mermaid flowchart (flowchart TD or graph TD) showing all 6 workflows, their key nodes, and human gate positions (marked with a distinct label)
README has a node reference table with columns: Workflow | Node | Type | Human Gate (✓ / —) covering every node in every workflow
README has a Quick Start section covering install → run install hook → run first workflow in exactly 3 numbered steps
README has a Configuration Reference section documenting every key in .archon/unic-dlc.config.json with: key name, type, default value, valid values, description
README has a docs/workflow/ Layout section with a directory tree showing what files are created where and who owns each artifact (Archon vs. plugin vs. developer)
README has a Dependencies section: minimum Archon version requirement, statement that no peer Claude Code plugins are required
README does not list pr-review-toolkit as a dependency
Mermaid diagram is valid GitHub-renderable syntax
userStories.technicalNotes: Reference the 6 workflows as implemented in US-008 through US-013 and the review command from US-014. Configuration keys come from the DlcConfig typedef in config.mjs (US-002). Use Prettier-formatted markdown (2-space indentation for lists). Mermaid syntax: nodes in parentheses are prompt nodes, nodes in brackets are bash nodes, nodes in double brackets are interactive gates.

userStories.title: Initial version bump and CHANGELOG entry

Added section lists: 6 Archon workflows (explore, plan, build, qa, cleanup, triage), idempotent install hook, self-contained review command, 4 tested modules (config, explorer, tracker adapter, dep-tree + yaml-gen)
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc verify:changelog passes without error
Version in .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, and package.json are all 0.1.0
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc typecheck passes
pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc test passes
pnpm check passes (Biome + Prettier)
userStories.technicalNotes: CHANGELOG format follows apps/claude-code/auto-format/CHANGELOG.md exactly. Run pnpm --filter unic-archon-dlc sync-version if versions get out of sync between files. The verify:changelog script is from packages/release-tools/scripts/verify-changelog.mjs.
